description: This source file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs, specifically for supporting multiple types within the Orleans framework. It declares IGeneralizedCodec and ISpecializableCodec interfaces, which facilitate type support checking and retrieval of specialized codecs.

classes.name: IGeneralizedCodec
classes.description: Interface for a codec that supports multiple types, extending IFieldCodec. Provides a method to check if a type is supported.

classes.name: ISpecializableCodec
classes.description: Interface for a codec provider that can determine support for types and retrieve specialized codecs.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks whether a specified type is supported by the codec or provider.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Retrieves an IFieldCodec implementation supporting the specified type.
